{{Quote|You overestimate my powers and underestimate the sleep gas. I can barely move.|Qu Rahn to Pic after his capture|<ref name="dfra">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Sleeping gas''' or '''sleep gas''' was used to cause people to fall unconscious.

A [[Unidentified former Imperial storm commando|terrorist]] once used it in connection with an assassination attempt on [[Drextar Pym]].

[[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec's]] forces from the [[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|''Vengeance'']], boarding [[Duno Dree's transport]], filled the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] with sleeping gas. [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]] suggested to run to the storage lockers with the [[Environment suit/Legends|space suits]], but they fell moments later.<ref name="dfra" />
